Lemon Garlic Chix Thighs

6 bone-in skin-on chix thighs (about 2 1/2 lb)
1 lem - zest & juice
4 garlic cloves smashed
2 TBSP butter
1 T olive oil
1 tsp dried thyme
1/2 c chix broth
S & P

pat dry, season. sear skin down til crispy ~8 min. flip. add garlic, butter, broth, lemon. bake 400 20-25 min til 165. spoon sauce over
